get.description:
Streams run state changes and output lines as they happen.

**WebSocket endpoint.** Connect with a WebSocket upgrade request (`ws://` or `wss://`, sub-protocol `xrpc.json`). The client sends the JSON-RPC request `Control.Watch` with the single `WatchRequest` message as `params`; the server then sends any number of `xrpc.message` notifications carrying `Event` messages in `params.data`, and ends the stream with the response to the request (`result` is null). Notifications are JSON-RPC objects with `params` of the form `{"id": <request id>, "data": <message>}`; a client aborts a stream with an `xrpc.cancel` notification.
